A.rationale: A1 wins on concrete tier numbers, file paths, latency budgets, provenance mapping, test counts, and canary plan. A2 has broader persona count but leaves algorithm selection and eight open questions unresolved.

B.rationale: B1 wins on owner/due-date/enforcement specificity, two-control-loop discipline, and provenance. B2 has breadth but lacks owners, due dates, real debate, and traceability.

C.rationale: C1 wins through the Trust Contract structure, buyer-veto framing, audit field schemas, decision-record concept, and provenance table. C2 is competent but generic and lacks debate convergence.
